name: ContextLift
author: ContextLift

sections.description:
ContextLift is a powerful AI-powered internal linking plugin for WordPress that automates your SEO strategy by intelligently building contextual links across your website.

Unlike traditional SEO plugins that require manual setup, ContextLift learns your content structure and automatically improves your internal linking, helping search engines crawl and rank your content more effectively.

Whether you’re managing a blog, niche site, or content-heavy website, ContextLift saves hours of manual work while improving your rankings.

🚀 Why Choose ContextLift?

Unlike typical SEO plugins that focus only on optimization suggestions, ContextLift actively takes action.

  • Automatically builds internal links across your site
  • Reduces click depth to improve crawlability
  • Eliminates orphan pages
  • Improves keyword relevance across content
  • Saves hours of manual SEO work

All features are 100% free — no locked modules, no upsells, no limitations.

🔥 Key Features

  • AI Internal Linking Automation: Automatically create contextual internal links based on your content and keyword relationships.
  • Click Depth Analyzer: Identify pages that are too deep and improve site structure for better indexing.
  • Heading Audit & Auto Fix: Detect missing or incorrect H1–H6 tags and fix them instantly.
  • Keyword Mapping System: Assign and manage primary and secondary keywords for every post.
  • Bulk Internal Linking: Automatically link orphan pages in safe, optimized batches.
  • Link Log & Revisions: Track and undo internal links with full control.
  • Scheduled Automation: Daily scans and weekly full site optimization using WP-Cron.

⚔️ Why ContextLift Over Other SEO Plugins?

Many SEO plugins provide suggestions but still require manual effort.

ContextLift goes further by automating internal linking and SEO improvements using AI — completely free.

You don’t need to manually search for linking opportunities or spend hours optimizing your site.

📈 What You Can Achieve

  • Boost search rankings with better internal linking
  • Improve crawlability and indexing
  • Increase time on site with smart link placement
  • Strengthen topical authority
  • Scale SEO without extra effort

🧠 Built for Performance

ContextLift runs in the background using efficient processes and does not impact your website’s front-end performance.

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services during normal operation. All processing is performed locally on your WordPress server.

The plugin UI includes a “License” tab which is currently inactive and does not transmit any data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/contextlift directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open ContextLift from your dashboard.
  4. Click “Rebuild Context” to scan your content.
  5. Start automating your internal linking instantly.
sections.faq:
Does ContextLift slow down my website?

No. All heavy processing runs in the background via WP-Cron and admin-side execution. Your front-end remains fast.

Can I undo links created by the plugin?

Yes. You can manage and revert all links from the Link Log section.

Is this plugin really free?

Yes. All features are completely free with no hidden limitations.

Can I control where links are created?

Yes. You can configure settings to control linking behavior, categories, and rules.
